events.title: Freddie Mercury's 35th Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' – an album that changed everything. Still sounds fresh, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon's 46th Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's message of peace still resonates today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the riff, Jimmy Page. Rock on!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Still sailing, still rocking. Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... playing some Madness for Suggs' 66th birthday today!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wherever I lay my hat, that's my home... and today it's home to Paul Young's 71st birthday celebrations!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Working 9 to 5 and still sparkling at 81. Happy birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Forever our greatest day. Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and celebrate Billy Ocean's 77th birthday with us!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's 38th Anniversary
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to legends. Who would be your first inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Still shining bright! Happy 55th birthday to the wonderful Mark Owen.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert 58th Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on a London rooftop on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their legendary final live performance. Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary musician Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: In the air tonight... we're celebrating Phil Collins' 76th birthday! What's your favourite Genesis or solo track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: From rom-com king to villain, Hugh Grant turns 67 today. What's your favourite of his films?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Bringing sexy back since '95. Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake!

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959.

angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since 'The Day The Music Died'. A tragic loss that changed music forever, but their songs live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down... especially on your 61st birthday, Rick Astley!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82

angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, and his music still unites us.

events.title: Carole King turns 85

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: From songwriting genius to solo star, happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King!

events.title: Whitney Houston's 15th Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day 15 years ago.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the most powerful voices of all time. Whitney Houston, forever missed.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the world stopped for Take That fans. Thankfully, they came back stronger! What was your reaction?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and a happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell!

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Thinking out loud... it's Ed Sheeran's 36th birthday! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison 84th
angles.copy: Here comes the sun... and a tribute to George Harrison, who would have been 84 today. A quiet Beatle, a powerful voice.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83

angles.copy: Hope I die before I get old? Not Roger Daltrey! Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's iconic frontman.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69

angles.name: Nik Kershaw Birthday
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good... to celebrate Nik Kershaw's 69th birthday with some of his greatest hits?

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin Birthday
angles.copy: It was all yellow... and now it's 50! Happy birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Jon Bon Jovi Birthday
angles.copy: Living on a prayer and turning 65! Happy birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Remembering singer-songwriter Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea 76th
angles.copy: Driving home for Christmas... or just listening to Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today. A true British music legend.
